payload.adrs:
SIX DECIDING ADRs minted, each naming in its own text the requirements and criteria that forced it, and each recording what was rejected with the reason. Tracing is in the records rather than in edges because the requirements live as evidence prose rather than as ledger nodes - the engine correctly refused set_field on `addresses` and `rejected`, which are edge kinds, and that refusal is itself a small proof that the guard rails work.

se.adr-git-is-the-only-searcher - THE DECIDING ONE. Git serves both the working tree and the record; no ripgrep, no second engine, no fallback. Forced by R3-R6 and criteria C1/C2/C3/C5. Records that it REVERSES an owner expectation under that same owner's instruction to research and use whatever is better, and that the better answer was no new dependency at all. Rejections carry their reasons: ripgrep (unexercised here, adds a dependency and a second output shape), system ripgrep (probed absent), ast-grep (answers a question nothing asks), index servers and embeddings (freshness veto), keeping the hand-rolled searcher (the no-duplicate-code ruling).

se.adr-locate-and-read-are-separate - search returns positions, the reader returns context. Forced by a real constraint: git grep -z gives clean fields OR the match/context marker, never both. The resolution follows the function structure already drawn - LOCATE and DELIVER-IN-PORTIONS are separate functions - so the constraint landed on a boundary the design already had.

se.adr-untracked-files-are-searched-by-default - the caller opts OUT. Inverts git's own default because the untracked case IS this agent's dominant pattern, and a flag that must be remembered is a defect waiting for the one time it is not.

se.adr-applies-to-becomes-a-selector - applies_to becomes machine-readable; ten nodes migrate. Forced by R14/R15 and the probe that killed the obvious mechanism. The semantic alternative is rejected but explicitly NOT dead - an M5 spike measures it before it is finally discarded, because rejecting it on my prior is exactly the move this iteration exists to stop.

se.adr-a-lint-decides-or-defers - pass, fail, or defer; never park, never judge intent. Forced by R16-R19 and by se.law-responsibility-never-delegates. Carries the corollary ruled in advance: a lint that fires wrongly is a defect to remove, never a cost to absorb - decided now precisely so it is not renegotiated when a lint is inconvenient at 3am.

se.adr-the-hash-is-the-pointer-the-tag-is-the-name - the grant records the commit hash; the tag is annotated; the branch is deleted after merge. Every clause is forced by something OBSERVED rather than argued: lightweight tags are dropped by push.followTags (verified), and git itself warned that iter/i8d-phone-brief is ambiguous (probed).

NO ADR WAS WRITTEN FOR: the batch-patch shape, se_config, or required-arg enforcement. Deliberate - those are requirements with one obvious realization and no contested alternative, and an ADR for a decision nobody could have made differently is decision theatre. Recording the omission so it reads as a judgement rather than a gap.
